title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Unbalanced Bids
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: During bid tabulation for a road project, the buyer notes the vendor priced 'Phase 1: Mobilization' at an exorbitant rate, but priced 'Phase 4: Final Paving' at pennies. The overall total price makes them the low bidder. This pricing strategy is known as:
questions.explain: Unbalanced bidding (specifically front-end loading) occurs when a contractor artificially inflates the prices of early work items and deflates later items to receive advance working capital early in the project.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: An unbalanced bid should typically be rejected as non-responsive if it is deemed 'Materially Unbalanced.' A bid is materially unbalanced when:
options: The numbers on the page are not aligned correctly
There is a reasonable doubt that awarding to the bidder will result in the lowest ultimate cost to the agency
The bidder requires a 30-day payment term instead of 45 days
questions.explain: A bid is materially unbalanced if the skewed pricing structures pose an unacceptable financial risk, creating doubt that the superficially low total bid will actually yield the lowest final cost to the government.
